content: Zzect n tajjač

Ict zi temɣarin n ayt n inabiyyen třaɣa i Ilicaɛ, tenna: “Amsexxar nnec, aryaz inu, immut, uca cek tessned belli amsexxar nnec tuɣa itteggʷed SIDI. Řexxu maca yusa-dd bab n wareṭṭař, ḥima ad iksi akides tnayen n iḥenjiren inu d isemɣan.”
Inna as Ilicaɛ: “Min zemmareɣ ad am ggeɣ? Ini ayi min ɣarem di taddart.” Nettat tarra-dd xas: “Tayya nnec war ɣares walu mɣir ict n tɣarraft dayes zzect.”
Xenni inna: “Ttar i yixef nnem tiqduḥin barra i taddart, tiqduḥin n jjiran nnem xwant, ḥḍa war iřint drus.
Xenni adef ɣar daxeř uca belleɛ tawwart awarni am u awarni i iḥenjiren nnem. Farreɣ xenni zzect di marra tiqduḥin nni, u min iǧan iccur, sars i-t ɣar uɣezdis!”
Xas uca tuyur xas uca tbelleɛ tawwart awarni as u awarni i iḥenjiren nnes. Nitni iwyen ɣares tiqduḥin u nettat tfarreɣ daysent zzect.
Umi ccurent marra tiqduḥin, tenna i mmis: “Awi ayi-dd ɛad ict n teqduḥt!”, maca netta yarra-dd xas: “War da teqqim ca teqduḥt ɛad!” U zzect tuɣa teqḍa.
Nettat tuyur ad tt txebbar i weryaz n AREBBI u wanita inna: “Uyur, zenz zzect u xeǧeṣ bab n wareṭṭař nnem u zi min ɣa iqqimen ad zzayes teddared, cem ak-d iḥenjiren nnem.”
Ilicaɛ d mmis n temɣart zi Cunam

Deg ijj n wass umi dd-ikka Ilicaɛ x Cunam, imsar, aqa ict n temɣart icennɛen issbedd i-t din, ḥima ad ɣares icc. Řebda umi tuɣa dd-ittekk x tendint nni, imsar, aqa iḥeyyed x webrid nnes ɣar din, ḥima ad icc ca n macca.
Nettat maca tenna i weryaz nnes: “Xzar, necc uciɣ aqa aryaz-a i ɣarneɣ dd-yusin řebda, aqa-t d aryaz amqeddas.

Ejj aneɣ ad nebna sennej ijj n wexxam d tameẓyant s řeḥyuḍ, uca ad negg din ijj n qama, ict n ṭṭabřa, ijj n řkursi d ijj n řefnar i netta. Mařa netta xenni yusa-dd ɣarneɣ, izemmar ad dinni iɛzeř ixef nnes.”
Deg ijj n wass imsar aqa Ilicaɛ yusa-dd din uca iɛzeř ixef nnes deg wexxam n nnej uca iruḥ izzeř dinni.
Xenni inna netta i umsexxar nnes Jiḥazi: “Řaɣa-dd i Tcunamect tanita!” Netta iřaɣa as u nettat tbedd zzat i wudem nnes.

Netta tuɣa i d as innan i umsexxar nnes: “Ini as: ‘Cem tᵉthillid dayneɣ aṭṭas. Min izemmar ad am ittwagg? Ma ad taɣ din ict n řḥajjet min xef nzemmar ad nessiweř ak-d ujeǧid niɣ ak-d ukumandar ameqqran n řɛeskar di ṭṭweɛ nnem?’” Maca nettat tenna: “Necc zeddɣeɣ di řwesṭ n řgens inu.”
Xenni tuɣa inna: “Min izemmaren ad as ittwagg?” Uca inna Jiḥazi: “Nettat war ɣares aḥenjir u aryaz nnes iwsar.”
Xenni tuɣa inna netta “Řaɣa-dd xas!” U netta iřaɣa-dd xas uca teqqim nettat tbedd di tewwart,
uca netta inna: “Di řweqt-a ittwaggen, ɣar tsaɛɛet n tudart, ad teksid aḥenjir deg iɣaǧen nnem.” Uca nettat tenna: “Lla, a sidi inu, a aryaz n AREBBI, war sxarriq zeɛma x tayya nnec!”
Tamɣart tedweř teksi s ddeyset uca turuw-dd ijj n uḥenjir di řweqt ittwaggen, ɣar řweqt n tudart nni x tuɣa issiweř Ilicaɛ akides.
Umi imɣar uḥenjir, imsar deg ijj n wass, iffeɣ-dd barra ɣar babas, ɣar yinni imejjaren.
Inna i babas: “A azeǧif inu, a azeǧif inu!” Uca babas inna i yijj n umsexxar: “Arbu t ɣar yemmas!”
Netta yarbu t uca yiwyi t ɣar yemmas. Netta tuɣa ittɣima x ifadden nnes ař azal, xenni immut.
Nettat tgeɛɛed sennej, tessars i-t x qama n weryaz n AREBBI. Tbelleɛ tawwart xas uca teffeɣ.
Třaɣa-dd x weryaz nnes, tenna as: “Sekk ayi-dd ijjen zeg imsexxaren d ijj zi teɣyař, ḥima ad uyureɣ deɣya ɣar weryaz n AREBBI u xenni ad ɛeqbeɣ ɛawed.”
Netta inna: “Mayemmi ɣa tuyured ɣares ass-a? Aqa war iǧi d abeddi n uyur u war iǧi d ssebt.” Nettat tenna: “Kuřci ad yiři mliḥ!”
Nettat tbardeɛ i teɣyuč u tenna i umsexxar nnes: “Ndeh i-tt, qqim ggur. Am tnedhed war tbeddi di ṭṭweɛ inu mɣir xmi d ac t i ɣa iniɣ.”
Nettat teffeɣ uca tiweḍ-dd ɣar weryaz n AREBBI, ɣar wedrar n Karmil. Umi tt iẓra netta zi řaggʷaj, inna i Jiḥazi, amsexxar nnes: “Xzar, aqa din d Tacunamect.”
Řexxu, uyur deɣya, řqa tt uca ini as: ‘Ma aqa cem mliḥ? Ma aryaz nnem aqa-t mliḥ? Ma aḥenjir nnem aqa-t mliḥ?’” Uca nettat tenna: “Aqa-ten mliḥ!”

Umi maca dd-tusa ɣar weryaz n AREBBI x wedrar, tqebbeḍ nettat x iḍaren nnes. Jiḥazi yudef-dd din ḥima ad tt iɛarn ɣar uɣezdis, maca aryaz n AREBBI inna: “Aḥta as, maɣar řeɛmar nnes icḍen dayes u SIDI issnuffar xafi min xef u war d ayi issargeb ca.”
Tenna nettat: “Ma necc ttareɣ i sidi inu ijj n mmi? Ma war nniɣ necc: ‘War d ayi cemmet’?”

Inna netta i Jiḥazi: “Byes tajɛinna nnec, ksi taɣɣarct inu deg ufus nnec uca ṭṭef abrid! Mařa cek temmeřqid ca n yijj, war xas ttseǧam, u mařa iseǧem xak ḥed, war xas dd-ttarri ca! Sars taɣɣarct inu x uɣembub n uḥenjir!”
Maca yemmas n uḥenjir tenna: “S tidett am iddar SIDI u iddar řeɛmar inu, necc war xak ttḥeyyideɣ ca!” Netta ikkar, iḍfar i-tt.
Tuɣa Jiḥazi izwar deɣya zzatsen u issars taɣɣarct x uɣembub n uḥenjir, maca netta war iggi ca řḥess uřa d twarrit. Xenni iɛqeb ḥima ad xas iřqa, uca iḥaja as t, inna: “Aḥenjir war dd-ifiq.”
Umi dd-yusa Ilicaɛ ɣar taddart, tuɣa immut uḥenjir, immars x qama nnes.
Yudef netta ɣar wexxam, ibelleɛ tawwart awarni asen s tnayen idsen uca iẓẓuǧ i SIDI.

Xenni ibedd zzat i qama, iwḍa tiwa n uḥenjir uca issars netta aqemmum nnes x uqemmum nnes, tiṭṭawin nnes x tiṭṭawin nnes, ifassen nnes x ifassen nnes. Netta issbuzzeř ammu tiwa nnes uca teḥma arrimet n uḥenjir.
Xenni iɛqeb-dd, yuyur di taddart da d diha, igeɛɛed twařa nneɣnit uca issbuzzeř ixef nnes tiwa nnes. Řexdenni iɛḍes uḥenjir sebɛa n twařawin uca xenni yarzem uḥenjir tiṭṭawin nnes.
Iřaɣa-dd netta i Jiḥazi, inna: “Řaɣa-dd x Tcunamect!” Uca netta iřaɣa-dd xas uca tusa-dd nettat ɣares, uca inna Ilicaɛ: “Arbu mmim!”
Tudef nettat din, tewḍa ɣar iḍaren nnes uca yuḍar as s uɣembub nnes ɣar tammurt. Xenni teksi mmis uca teffeɣ ɣar barra.
Řmewt di marmita d lmuɛjiza n usecci
Umi dd-iɛqeb Ilicaɛ ɣar Jiljal, tuɣa din řaẓ di temmurt u ayt n inabiyyen qqimen zzates. Inna netta i umsexxar nnes: “Egg marmita d tameqqrant u egg taḥrirt i ayt n inabiyyen.”

Xenni dd-iffeɣ ijjen zzaysen yuyur ɣar weḥwic barra, ḥima ad dd-yawi tibbi. Netta yufa ijj n wezbir n řexřa uca iřqeḍ-dd zzayes ařami iccur ubeḥrur n warruḍ nnes s texsact n řexřa. Xenni iɛqeb-dd uca iqess i-ten di marmita. Aqa nitni war tt ssinen.

Xenni farɣen aya i iryazen, ḥima ad ccen. Umi qqasen nitni zi teḥrirt-a, imsar, aqa nitni sɣuyen deg ujenna, řaɣan: “A, yeryaz n AREBBI, řmewt aqa-tt di marmita!” Uca nitni war zemmaren ad zzayes ccen.
Netta inna: “Awi ayi-dd drus n waren!” Netta issuyes i-t di marmita, inna: “Farɣem aya i řgens, ḥima ad ccen!” Xenni idweř war dinni ca war iḥři di marmita.
Yusa-dd ijj n weryaz zi Baɛl-Calica, yiwi-dd i weryaz n AREBBI aɣrum zi ṣṣabet tamenzut, ɛicrin n iɣrumen n imendi d řḥebb ibaryen n imendi deg ict n tecyart, uca netta inna: “Ewc man aya i řgens.”
Maca wanita inna: “Mammec t i ɣa ssarseɣ i mya n yeryazen?” Netta maca inna: “Ewc i-t i řgens ad t yecc, maɣar ammu i iqqar SIDI: ‘Ad ccen u ɛad ad iceṭṭ’.”
Netta issars asen t uca ccin nitni, u iceṭṭ xasen am mammec tuɣa inna wawař n SIDI.
